about.title: About
about.lead: ViMai is an independent software project focused on building an application ecosystem for learning, health, and everyday utilities. Our mission is to provide clear, practical software tools that help users with specific needs: certification exam study, children's education, and daily health tracking.
about.storyBody: Guided by “Building Vietnam's Future,” ViMai is not only about passing an exam. It is about durable learning and daily wellbeing.
about.missionP1: ViMai is an independent software project focused on building an application ecosystem for learning, health, and everyday utilities. Our mission is to provide clear, practical software tools that help users with specific needs: certification exam study, children's education, and daily health tracking. We do not promise exam passes or medical outcomes. Each product is a support tool, and its release status is stated on this website.
about.missionP2: Each app starts from a practical problem, not from visual effects. Tokutei Taxi and ViMai Transport support Specified Skilled Worker study in taxi and transport, and ViMai Tokutei Kaigo covers the two care (介護) exams. ViMai Seibishi 3kyu supports Class 3 automobile mechanic theory. ViMai Menkyo helps Vietnamese and English speakers study for the Japanese driving-licence theory test (Karimen, Honmen, licence conversion). ViMai Kids is an interactive learning platform designed for parents to follow. Maimai logs personal lifestyle metrics such as sleep, water, nutrition, and cycle tracking. ViCare is a free, non-profit app that helps Vietnamese people see a doctor in Japan: an interpreter for the visit, reading papers and medicine bags, choosing a department and calling an ambulance. The interface is intentionally calm: fast pages, readable type, and a clear order of information on mobile. Visitors should see what a product does, who it is for, and where its limits are on the first visit.
about.missionP3: Data protection is an operating requirement, not decoration. This website collects only what is needed to answer inquiries, run the CMS, and (if you choose to send feedback) moderate that feedback. Email addresses are not published. We do not sell personal data. The public site runs on Cloudflare. The Privacy Policy explains processing, cookies, your rights, and how to contact us. When a product is used by children, a parent or guardian is responsible for supervision.
about.scope1: Tokutei Gino exam prep for taxi, transport and care (kaigo)
about.scope2: Class 3 automobile mechanic and Japanese driving theory exam prep
about.qualityBody: Facts only where confirmed, readable Japanese, and a calm interface. Unreleased products are labeled clearly; missing details are marked for CMS update.
about.scope5: Helping Vietnamese people see a doctor in Japan (ViCare, free and non-profit)
about.vicareTitle: ViCare: no one should see a doctor in Japan alone
about.vicareBody: ViCare is ViMai's free, non-profit app for Vietnamese people living in Japan. From feeling unwell to choosing a department, finding a clinic, talking with the doctor and taking your medicine home, ViCare goes with you in Vietnamese, Japanese with furigana, and English.
about.vicarePoint1: An interpreter for the visit, with thousands of Japanese–Vietnamese phrases and furigana you can read straight to the doctor
about.vicarePoint2: Clinics by department on Google Maps, with data for all 47 prefectures from Japan's official 医療情報ネット
about.vicarePoint3: What to say when calling 119, #7119 or #8000, and an emergency medical card to show doctors and nurses
about.vicarePoint4: No account and no ads; your health records stay on your phone

legal.privacyIntro: This policy describes how vimai.jp (the "Website") handles information when you browse the ViMai ecosystem hub, send a contact message, submit optional feedback, or when staff sign in to the CMS. ViMai does not invent unconfirmed legal details. Translations help readers; they do not create a separate contract.
legal.whoBody: The Website is operated by the independent software project ViMai. Contact address: Ninh Binh, Vietnam. Support email: support@vimai.jp. Please use that email for all requests.
legal.collectBody: Information you submit: name, email, subject and message on the Contact form; display name, message, optional rating and optional country on community feedback. Technical minimums: IP address, user agent and timestamps may be used to rate-limit forms and reduce spam. Admin data: login email and an HttpOnly session cookie for authorised CMS users. This public website does not collect payment card numbers. Do not send medical details, identity documents or children's data in public forms. Product apps such as Maimai or ViMai Kids are described here; this hub does not collect their in-app health or learning records unless you type them into a form.
legal.useBody: We use data to answer product, press or partnership questions; to operate, secure and debug the Website and CMS; to moderate feedback before publication (email is never published); and to keep limited security logs. We may improve public copy from repeated questions. We do not build advertising profiles from contact forms unless a future ad network is disclosed on this page.
legal.legalBasisBody: For users in Japan, processing follows the Act on the Protection of Personal Information (APPI) where it applies. Bases include responding to your request, legitimate operation and security, and consent when you submit feedback for review. We do not use form data for automated legal decisions about you.
legal.shareBody: ViMai does not sell personal data. Processors needed to run the Website currently include Cloudflare (network, DNS, Pages, D1, and media storage if enabled). CMS access is limited to authorised staff. We may disclose information if Vietnamese law requires it. Approved feedback shows only the display name and text you submitted.
legal.cookiesBody: The admin session cookie (vimai_session) is HttpOnly and is not an advertising cookie. If Cloudflare Web Analytics is enabled, it is privacy-oriented and does not use ad cookies. Dashboard figures may be approximate.
legal.adsBody: If Google AdSense or a similar network is placed on the Website, Google and partners may use cookies or identifiers to serve, measure and protect ads under Google's policies. ViMai does not sell email lists to advertisers. You can adjust Google ad settings and browser controls. Ads are not ViMai editorial content. We do not use children's data or health-app data from our products to target ads.
legal.retentionBody: Contact and feedback records stay in the CMS until handled or until a reasonable deletion request. Anti-abuse logs are kept only as long as needed. Admin accounts last while staff need access. Backups, if any, expire on the provider's cycle.
legal.securityBody: The public site runs on Cloudflare. Admin sessions use a secure cookie and hashed passwords; plaintext passwords are not stored in source. No system is risk-free. If a breach affecting contact data is confirmed, we will notify as applicable law requires.
legal.childrenBody: vimai.jp is written for adults evaluating products. ViMai Kids is a children's learning product, but this hub does not ask children to create accounts. Do not submit a child's data in contact forms. A parent or guardian must supervise use of children's products. If we receive a child's data by mistake, we will delete it when identified.
legal.transferBody: Cloudflare may process data in more than one region. Sending a form from Vietnam, Japan or elsewhere may involve processing outside your country, within the provider's and applicable law's limits.
legal.rightsBody: Depending on APPI and the law of your residence, you may ask what contact data we hold, and request correction, deletion or restriction where a basis exists. Email us from the address you used, and state the request. We may take reasonable steps to verify identity. Rights can be limited where law requires records or where others' rights are affected.
legal.contactUsBody: Email: support@vimai.jp. Contact address: Ninh Binh, Vietnam. We reply within a reasonable time after we have enough information to identify the request.
legal.changesBody: If processing changes (for example ads, payments, or a confirmed legal entity), we update this page and the effective date. Continued use after publication means you have had the chance to read the new version. The public website is the current text.
legal.termsIntro: vimai.jp introduces the ViMai application ecosystem. By using the site you agree to use the information to learn about products, not to impersonate the brand, and not to attack the infrastructure.
legal.termsScopeBody: Product pages describe intended or in-progress features. Status labels (idea, development, coming soon, available) appear on each product. App Store, Google Play, Japanese national exams and other third-party services have their own terms. ViMai does not speak for those parties.
legal.termsUseOfSiteBody: Do not submit unlawful content, spam, malware, or another person's data without authority. The contact form is for product, press and partnership questions. Administrators may refuse or remove abusive material.
legal.termsProductsBody: Store listings (when live) and Web App / add-to-home-screen installs are different channels. The Web App guide does not replace Apple or Google terms. Study products do not guarantee exam results. Health-logging products are not medical devices and do not diagnose, treat or prevent disease.
legal.termsLiabilityBody: The Website is provided as is. To the extent allowed by law, ViMai is not liable for indirect loss from relying on introductory copy or from network interruption. Fuller terms will be added when the operating entity is confirmed.
legal.termsLawBody: To the extent permitted, these terms are interpreted under the laws of Vietnam. Please try to resolve disputes first by emailing support@vimai.jp.

ctvJoin.title: Become a ViMai marketing partner
ctvJoin.lead: Introduce ViMai's exam-prep apps to friends, study groups and the Vietnamese community in Japan. Customers who buy VIP with your code get a discount, and you earn a commission on every successful order, with no cap. Work online, no upfront cost.
ctvJoin.step1Body: Fill in the form at the bottom of this page. ViMai gets back to you with your own referral code and a private page to track your orders.
ctvJoin.step2Body: Recommend the apps with your code on Facebook, Zalo, TikTok, study groups or Japanese classes. One code works for every app that sells VIP on the web.
ctvJoin.step3Body: Customers enter your code when they buy VIP on the web and get 10–20% off (usually 15%), paying by VietQR bank transfer.
ctvJoin.step4Body: You earn a fixed commission per successful order. ViMai pays by bank transfer twice a month: for the 1st–15th and for the 16th to month end.
ctvJoin.perk1Body: Every successful VIP order with your code earns a commission, with no limit on orders. The more people you bring, the more you earn. ViMai agrees your exact rate with you when issuing your code.
ctvJoin.perk2Body: Tokutei Taxi, Tokutei Transport, Tokutei Kaigo and ViMai Menkyo: mock exams with furigana and Vietnamese explanations, with a free trial before buying.
ctvJoin.perk3Body: Each partner gets a private page only they can see: your code, every use of it, orders this period, your rank and unpaid commission. It updates automatically after each customer pays.
ctvJoin.perk4Body: Work online from Japan or Vietnam, with no upfront cost or sales experience needed. ViMai provides text and images for your posts.
ctvJoin.fit1: Technical interns, students and workers living in Japan
ctvJoin.fit2: Admins of groups, Facebook pages or TikTok channels about life in Japan
ctvJoin.fit3: Japanese teachers, language centres and agencies sending people to Japan
ctvJoin.fit4: People who passed Tokutei or the driving test and want to share how they studied
ctvJoin.rule1: Codes apply only to VIP bought on the web by VND bank transfer. Purchases in the iOS app do not use codes.
ctvJoin.rule2: Each customer can use a code once per app. Refunded orders earn no commission.
ctvJoin.rule3: Be honest: never promise a pass, no spam, and no use of exam bodies' names or logos.
ctvJoin.rule4: ViMai may pause a code that breaks these rules.
ctvJoin.applyLead: Send your details with the form below. ViMai replies by email, usually within a few days.
ctvJoin.applyPlaceholder: Are you in Japan or Vietnam, where will you share (Facebook, Zalo, TikTok links...), and roughly how many followers do you have?
ctvJoin.homeLead: Introduce ViMai apps to the Vietnamese community in Japan. Customers get a discount and you earn a commission on every VIP order, with no cap. Track it all on your own dashboard and the period leaderboard.
ctvJoin.perk5Body: A public leaderboard for each half month shows where you stand. It lists partner numbers only, never names or earnings.
